mapper.insert: insert into sys_project (name, content, type, money, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{content}, #{type}, #{money}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select sp.type as name, count(*) as value from sys_project sp join sys_item si on sp.id = si.project_id where date_format(si.create_time, '%Y') like concat('%', #{year}, '%') group by sp.type

select sp.name as ItemName, sum(ss.score) as scoreNumber from sys_score ss join sys_project sp on ss.project_id = sp.id left join sys_item si on sp.id = si.project_id where date_format(si.create_time, '%Y') like concat('%', #{year}, '%') group by ss.project_id order by sum(ss.score) desc limit 1

select sp.money as money, si.project_id as id, IFNULL((select sp.process from (select sp.* from sys_process sp where sp.is_process = 'YES') sp where sp.project_id = si.project_id group by sp.process order by process limit 1), "未审核") as status from sys_item si join sys_user su on si.create_by = su.id left join sys_project sp on sp.id = si.project_id where date_format(si.create_time, '%Y') like concat('%', #{year}, '%')
